WITH ping AS (
                UPDATE v2_job_runtime SET ping = null WHERE id = $2
            ), place AS (
                UPDATE concurrency_key ck
                SET original_scheduled_for = q.scheduled_for,
                    place = COALESCE(ck.place, q.scheduled_for),
                    tag = COALESCE(ck.tag, q.tag),
                    priority = COALESCE(ck.priority, q.priority, -32768)
                FROM v2_job_queue q
                WHERE ck.job_id = $2 AND q.id = $2 AND ck.original_scheduled_for IS NULL
            )
            UPDATE v2_job_queue SET
                running = false,
                started_at = null,
                scheduled_for = $1
            WHERE id = $2
